notes:
Export PDF for Bluebeam: a drawing with Drawing Colours set now stays sharp at any zoom. The drawing keeps its own lines and text in the PDF and only the grey is laid over it, instead of a picture of the whole sheet. The exported file is also smaller.
The grey is still on the Drawing Colours layer: in Bluebeam, press Alt+Y to open Layers and untick it to see the drawing as issued.
